title: fieldwork::funkwhale_api — Funkwhale Client API route handlers
description: Implement Funkwhale API endpoints. Key endpoints: /api/v1/tracks, /api/v1/albums, /api/v1/artists, /api/v1/playlists, /api/v1/listen, /api/v1/channels, /api/v1/subscriptions. Subsonic API compatibility would also unlock many existing music player apps.
